provenance.note: the closed-instance method and the four shape classes are the build spec's; this instantiation — the choice of era, the operands, the probes, the capability sets — was written during the build

axes.material_environment: water, wind and animal power; gears cut by hand; the pendulum newly regulated
axes.artifact: the escapement clock and the orrery — the most impressive machines of the era
axes.science_as_practised: a result was a mechanism exhibited: gears, contact, transmitted determination
axes.epistemology: to know a thing was to be able to build one that did the same

frame.claim: the cosmos is a mechanism: bodies move by fixed rule, set going once and thereafter running without further intervention

criterion.name: understanding = exhibit a mechanism that reproduces the motion

operands.name: absolute time
operands.note: the clock keeps one time for everything on it; the cosmos was granted the same

operands.name: rigid transmission
operands.note: gear teeth touch; the requirement of contact came from the gear train

operands.name: initial setting
operands.note: the winding is required by the frame and observed nowhere

operands.name: part decomposability
operands.note: a clock comes apart into parts because it was assembled from them
